content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I am experiencing an issue: when I connect to the [product_name] module and try to view the program online, it does not show the current values of the analog inputs and outputs. However, those values are visible on the [product_name] screen with [article_no]. What could be causing this? The first time I checked online values, I could see the analog input and output readings without any problems. After a few days, when I tried again, the program stopped showing the actual analog I/O values. Thank you for your assistance.
Could you provide a full screen capture of what you are seeing? Visual details would help us better understand your situation.

Hi, simply starting the online test is not enough. You must also initiate communication by clicking the glasses icon. Additionally, each function block has its own activation for this feature. You might not be able to view analog input and output values directly. If that's the case, try using an analog amplifier and enable its monitoring feature. Hope this is helpful.

Thank you for your answer, [user_name]. Sorry for the basic question—I've been dealing with a lot of stress lately and haven't been very focused. I appreciate your reminder; I had forgotten that step. In my workplace, I'm just starting to use [product_name] modules, while most machines are operated by [product_name] controllers, 300 and 400 series. Thanks again for your help.
Don't worry about it, friend. Everyone has moments like these. Just smile and move on. You already thanked us—now, just give us a smile.

analysis.insight_summary: A user reports difficulties seeing live analog input and output readings in the online program view of the [product_name] module, even though the device shows them on its own display. This suggests that certain communication settings or monitoring activations in the software are needed, and these details can be easily overlooked, especially when users are stressed or under pressure.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that real-time analog input and output values should be visible immediately in the [product_name] online program interface, without needing extra steps to activate or configure communication.
